title: Brief 2: agents busy, none measuring

headline: Only my own wake was measured, 70,242 fresh tokens: the four agents asked yesterday made 23 commits and no ledger line, so the biggest saving is still synthetic's long session and nothing moves until A1.

for_you.ask: Put the measure step in every agent's wake prompt (asked in brief 1)?
for_you.detail: Asking by commit does not work: conductor, dev, dashboard and designer made 23 commits since brief 1 and no ledger line. Old: '... do one run, release it, and report in five lines.' New: '... do one run, release it, run node people/indi/accountant/measure.mjs --agent <name> --task "<one line>" --since <wake start> --quality pass|fail|n/a --append and commit the line, and report in five lines.' Same line for the overnight prompts (people/indi/overnight/).
options: Yes, the conductor adds it to all
for_you.recommend: Yes, the conductor adds it to all

for_you.ask: Test persona sub-agents on Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 before synthetic users run 3 (brief 1)?
for_you.detail: Still open. Under 200,000 tokens, once. Messaging, factory and builder already run on Sonnet 5.5, so once they measure we get a free comparison too.

for_you.ask: A fresh session per wake for the conductor (brief 1)?
for_you.detail: Still open. Needs three measured wakes first, so it waits on A1.

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Unchanged from brief 1, no new data: synthetic's long session (21,674,843 cache reads, 173,399 per call), Opus 5.5 for all 111 persona calls, and 69,357 cache writes per sub-agent.
New: the four agents asked by commit ran 23 times without measuring. A1 is the only route to numbers.

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring
sections.text: Asked today, once each: messaging 2ee20ca3, factory cbf2af42, builder c0a22181, ux fc6debe2, journalist 9355d141, synthetic d7619da8 (line over 24 hours old). Asked yesterday, not again: conductor, dev, dashboard, designer.

sections.title: 5. Data notes and 6. My own use
sections.text: One ledger line in the window (mine, wake 1). Commit counts from git log. No estimates. My use since wake 1, including the friendly report and guide: in brief 3. Watch: my overhead is above the measured saving (none yet); if still so on 11 November, I propose a weekly brief.

next: 6 November, 17:30 UTC: brief 3. On a yes to A1, numbers from every agent from its next wake.
